summary:
Implemented the next Maintenance-to-Garage staging slice: Garage staging now supports local-only one-off store items for extras like shop towels or trim clips. They show in a `One-Off Store Items` group, participate in Need/Staged counts and buy-list exports, can be removed, and stay outside Garage backup/sync unless the user explicitly saves a run/buy snapshot.
